build_CLIPBaseline_model: build a CLIPBaseline model with a visual encoder, textual encoder, and embedding dimension for image-text contrastive learning
build_MERU_model: build a MERU model with visual and textual encoders, embedding dimension, and curvature for hyperbolic image-text embedding
encode_image_CLIPBaseline: encode a batch of images into Euclidean feature vectors using the CLIPBaseline encode_image method with L2 normalization
encode_text_CLIPBaseline: encode a list of token tensors into Euclidean text features using the CLIPBaseline encode_text method
encode_image_MERU: encode a batch of images into hyperbolic embeddings on the Lorentz hyperboloid using the MERU encode_image method
